capabilities: Generate randomized practice questions from variables and formulas
Create custom exams from saved questions
Track exam history and grades in a study overview
extras: Author states the plugin will be actively maintained because they use it for their own studies.
motivation: The author built it mainly for themselves and other engineering students who reach for flashcards or past papers.
problem: Revising means hunting for past papers and re-answering the same fixed questions instead of getting fresh practice material.
summary: Exam generator that turns parameterized questions with random variables into new practice problems, exams and progress tracking.
